title: TWITTER X7 carbon aero road bike
notes: The exact current manufacturer page claims a complete-bike weight from approximately 7.6 kg and lists four drivetrain configurations: Sensah ES7000 1x14 wireless, Shimano 105 R7120 2x12, Shimano 105 R7170 Di2 2x12 and WheelTop EDS TX 2x12 wireless. It also documents T1000/T1100/T1K carbon, sizes 46-56, T47x24 and fitted INNOVA 700x30C tires, but no maximum tire clearance.
